notes.probe: The warm fire and canvas sit in the lower part of the vertical frame, with clear separation between the pale moon, layered dune crests, and the fine starfield.
notes.timeline: Gentle handheld drift shifts the moon and the low horizon as the fire flickers beside the tent. Cool dune layers and grain-scale wind ripples stay visible around the concentrated amber practicals. Shrub silhouettes sit on the distant sand. The painterly Freestyle lines appear on crests and camp edges.
notes.angles: The wide panel exposes the surrounding basin and wider starfield. The three-quarter proof shows the lantern-lit tent pitched on the sand and a compact camp around the fire. The overhead shows the fire stones, tent ropes, props, and scattered tufts around the camera's short move.
notes.jev_look_items: Jev scored noise at 0.53. The starfield and rippled sand supply fine texture across the shot. The 0.45 empty-frame score reflects the space above and around the camp in the vertical frame. The 0.55 unfinished-set score picks up the sparse terrain seen in the proof. The camp and surrounding ground read as a continuous basin.
